name: sketchup_ancient_tool
description: AncientArchitectureExperience 0.4: 12 bounded cards, 7 recipes, six roofs, source templates, bearing and eave diagnostics. Offline compile only; managed execution and real review remain required. family=geometry compiles explicit semantic parts through the shared guarded core for an exact project and phase; source fidelity still requires review. Runtime adapter 0.4.5 exposes all roof preset IDs and resolves recipe validation/compilation to source or roof.

format.description: read only; markdown returns the complete upstream 0.4 card with path and SHA256; default json is the adapted runtime card.

detail.description: For validate, default false returns a bounded validation summary without echoing large geometry parameters. Set true when the full validated parameter object is needed.
